Question: BISMI ASSALAM ALAIKUM I AM IN TROUBLE,I AM DOING JOB IN JAMIA URDU ALIGARH AS AN ACCOUNTANT , WHERE MANAGEMENT WANTS TO GET PAYMENT ON INCREASING BILLS AND SOME PAYMENT WHICH ARE NOT DUE. THEY ARE SWALLING MONEY FROM JAMIA URDU, THEY ARE CRIMINALS AND I DO NOT WANT TO CLASH WITH THEM. WHAT SHOULD I DO PLEASE TELL ME. Answer ID: 15614 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1593/1313=L=1430) If you prepare the bills or pass the bill, it is unlawful for you to prepare or pass fraudulent bills. You must refrain from it as much as possible. If the wrong bill was prepared or passed by any other person, you just have to make payment accordingly or record it in registers, it may be allowable, but avoiding is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
